description: This file is a C++ source file implementing command generation and build system integration functions for the GN build tool, including functions for generating ninja files, IDE project files, and handling build dependencies.

classes.name: TargetWriteInfo
classes.description: A structure to hold information for writing ninja rules per toolchain, including rules, ninja outputs, and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: BackgroundDoWrite
methods.description: Executes on a worker thread to generate ninja rules for a target and update shared data structures.

methods.name: ItemResolvedAndGeneratedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a build item has been resolved and generated, scheduling ninja file writing.

methods.name: FindTargetThatGeneratesFile
methods.description: Finds the target that generates a specific output file.

methods.name: PrintInvalidGeneratedInput
methods.description: Prints an error message for files that are inputs but not generated by dependencies.

methods.name: CheckForInvalidGeneratedInputs
methods.description: Checks for generated inputs that are not produced by dependencies and reports errors.

methods.name: RunIdeWriter
methods.description: Runs the appropriate IDE project generator based on the specified IDE name.

methods.name: RunRustProjectWriter
methods.description: Generates a rust-project.json file for Rust ecosystem tools.

methods.name: RunNinjaPostProcessTools
methods.description: Runs post-processing tools on ninja files, including cleaning and restating.

methods.name: WriteIgnoreFile
methods.description: Creates a .gitignore file in the build directory to ignore build artifacts.
